title.zh: 将南莱特省Hinunangan市镇Hinunangan社区医院床位由10张增至25张，并将其升格为区医院，名称为Hinunangan区医院，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Hinunangan Community Hospital in the Municipality of Hinunangan, Province of Southern Leyte, From Ten (10) To Twenty-five (25) Beds, Upgrading It Into A District Hospital To Be Known As the Hinunangan District Hospital, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Hinunangan Community Hospital in the Municipality of Hinunangan, Province of Southern Leyte, From Ten (10) To Twenty-five (25) Beds, Upgrading It Into A District Hospital To Be Known As the Hinunangan District Hospital, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tăng sức chứa giường bệnh của Bệnh viện Cộng đồng Hinunangan tại Đô thị Hinunangan, Tỉnh Southern Leyte từ 10 lên 25 giường, và phân bổ kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเพิ่มจำนวนเตียงของโรงพยาบาลชุมชน Hinunangan ในเทศบาล Hinunangan จังหวัด Southern Leyte จาก 10 เป็น 25 เตียง และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang meningkatkan kapasitas tempat tidur Rumah Sakit Komunitas Hinunangan di Kotamadya Hinunangan, Provinsi Southern Leyte dari 10 menjadi 25 tempat tidur, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta meningkatkan kapasiti katil Hospital Komuniti Hinunangan di Perbandaran Hinunangan, Wilayah Southern Leyte daripada 10 kepada 25 katil, serta memperuntukkan dana

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7542_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The bed capacity of the Hinunangan Community Hospital in the Municipality of Hinunangan, Province of Southern Leyte, is hereby increased from ten (10) to twenty-Five (25) beds and upgrading it into a district hospital to be known as the Hinunangan District Hospital.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
